cmd: echo "=== DISK ==="; df -h /; echo; echo "--- du /opt ---"; du -sh /opt/* 2>/dev/null; echo "--- du /etc/vps* ---"; du -sh /etc/vps-agent /etc/vps-github-bridge 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== MEMORY ==="; free -h; echo; echo "=== NETWORK ==="; ip -brief addr; echo; echo "=== CRON ==="; sudo crontab -l 2>/dev/null || crontab -l; echo; echo "=== SERVICES ==="; systemctl is-active vps-agent; systemctl is-active caddy; echo; echo "=== REPO TOP LEVEL ==="; ls -la /opt/weather-pipeline/repo | head -40; echo; echo "=== GIT LOG (last 5) ==="; cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo && git log --oneline -5; echo; echo "=== LOG TAIL bridge ==="; tail -15 /var/log/vps-github-bridge.log 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== LOG TAIL pipeline ==="; tail -25 /var/log/vps-pipeline.log 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== LOG TAIL satellite ==="; tail -25 /var/log/vps-satellite-pipeline.log 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== UPTIME/LOAD ==="; uptime
